rv.q: The One Where the 90s Never Ended: I Made You a Mixtape is a joyous, genre-defying, alt-rock-fuelled love letter to the 90s. The 90s are in vogue, and it’s easy to see why.

The women’s stories are told through whole-cast, solo, and group pieces, and Manning has instilled in the performers such energy and connection that it is compelling to watch. The choreographed routines are extremely slick, and the Meisner elements of the production are endlessly entertaining.

It’s a sort of dance show, driven by movement and music. Nine young women are at a 90s dorm party. All are, after this night, facing or about to encounter a life-changing event – a job change, a wedding, a baby, rehab, coming out, moving out, dropping out of school, an expiring visa, ending a relationship.
